prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic AAA third-person fantasy action-adventure RPG gameplay sequence set in a fictional ancient Korean mountain kingdom hidden among mist-covered mountains, dense pine forests, traditional Korean-inspired architecture, and enormous stone fortresses.

The video must look like genuine next-generation AAA open-world gameplay captured in-engine, with realistic 3D characters, responsive player-controlled traversal, supernatural abilities, believable physics, detailed environments, and seamless transitions between exploration, destruction, and combat.

This must be an ORIGINAL concept, not a recreation of the submerged Japanese temple, underwater guardian, collapsing bridge, or storyline from the reference creator's video. Create a distinctly Korean-inspired fantasy world with an original mission and creature encounter.

MAIN CHARACTER / IDENTITY LOCK:

Use the uploaded reference image as the exact identity reference for the protagonist. Preserve her facial identity, facial proportions, hairstyle, skin texture, body proportions and appearance consistently throughout the sequence.

She is a young Korean woman in her early 20s with long black hair, wearing practical fantasy adventurer clothing inspired by traditional Korean silhouettes: a fitted dark charcoal tunic with subtle embroidered detailing, muted crimson fabric panels, fitted black trousers, rugged leather boots, protective forearm wraps, and a small golden moonstone talisman attached to her belt.

Her outfit must feel like grounded premium fantasy game design, not a theatrical costume. Keep her face, hair, clothing, accessories and proportions consistent.

WORLD AND ENVIRONMENT:

A vast fictional ancient Korean mountain kingdom built around a sacred forest and ruined mountaintop fortress.

Include traditional Korean-inspired wooden pavilions, curved tiled rooftops, stone stairways carved into mountain cliffs, weathered fortress walls, ancient gates, dense pine trees, bamboo, mist-filled valleys, narrow mountain paths, hanging prayer ribbons, moss-covered stone lanterns, waterfalls and distant mountain peaks.

The architecture must be original and fictional, inspired by Korean historical visual language without copying a specific real temple or sacred monument.

Use cool natural mountain daylight, soft sunlight through pine branches, wet stone surfaces, drifting leaves, realistic fog, detailed environmental aging and atmospheric depth.

CAMERA AND GAMEPLAY:

Maintain a responsive over-the-shoulder third-person gameplay camera. Follow player movement naturally during running, climbing, jumping, combat and ability activation.

Widen the camera briefly for major environmental reveals and creature encounters, then return to standard gameplay framing.

No first-person perspective, disconnected montage, constant cinematic camera angles, artificial camera teleportation, excessive slow motion, or movie-trailer presentation.

HUD:

- Health and stamina bars in the upper-left.
- Circular compass and objective marker.
- Contextual interaction prompts.
- Spirit ability icons in the lower-right.
- Enemy health bar during the guardian encounter.
- Small mission notifications.

Keep the HUD minimal, screen-anchored and integrated into a real playable game.

CORE MISSION:

The protagonist enters a forbidden mountain shrine, retrieves an ancient moonstone, awakens a colossal supernatural white tiger guardian, escapes a collapsing fortress, and begins a boss battle on a mountain platform.

[00:00–00:04] — THE FORBIDDEN FORTRESS

Start directly in third-person gameplay. The protagonist sprints up a steep, wet stone staircase toward a gigantic ancient Korean-inspired fortress gate surrounded by mountain mist.

She jumps over a broken staircase, grabs the edge of a collapsed wooden platform, pulls herself up, and continues running. The camera follows naturally behind her.

She enters a ruined courtyard with moss-covered walls, traditional rooftops and tall pine trees.

Objective: “REACH THE MOON SHRINE”

SFX: Wet footsteps, mountain wind, distant waterfall, cloth movement, subtle orchestral tension.

[00:04–00:08] — THE MOONSTONE

Inside a partially ruined shrine chamber, the protagonist approaches a glowing pale-blue moonstone resting on a circular stone altar.

Prompt: “TAKE THE MOONSTONE”

She picks it up. Luminous patterns spread across the floor as ancient mechanisms activate.

Notifications:
“RELIC ACQUIRED”
“ANCIENT SEAL BROKEN”

The chamber begins trembling. The camera briefly moves closer to the interaction, then returns to third-person gameplay.

SFX: Stone mechanisms, low energy resonance, deep rumbling.

[00:08–00:12] — THE WHITE TIGER AWAKENS

A massive crack spreads across the rear shrine wall.

A gigantic supernatural white tiger guardian emerges from the darkness. It has realistic white fur, subtle gray markings, powerful musculature, glowing pale-gold eyes, and faint golden energy moving across its body.

The guardian steps forward and crushes a stone platform beneath its paw. Dust and fragments fall as the camera widens to reveal its enormous scale.

Boss health bar: “GUARDIAN OF THE MOUNTAIN”

SFX: Deep supernatural roar, breaking stone, heavy footfalls, dramatic score.

[00:12–00:17] — FORTRESS COLLAPSE

The guardian strikes the shrine wall, causing the fortress to collapse.

The protagonist sprints through the courtyard as wooden beams and roof tiles fall around her. She slides beneath a collapsing timber, jumps across a broken stone bridge, and grabs a hanging rope attached to an old wooden watchtower.

She swings over a deep ravine and lands on a narrow stone ledge. The camera follows the movement naturally, showing misty mountains and waterfalls below.

Objective: “ESCAPE THE FORTRESS”

SFX: Falling debris, cracking wood, rope tension, rushing wind, distant roar.

[00:17–00:21] — MOONSTEP ABILITY

The protagonist reaches a ruined mountain gate overlooking a fog-filled valley.

The moonstone glows intensely.

Prompt: “ACTIVATE MOONSTEP”

She activates the relic, creating a short luminous trail beneath her feet. She dashes across a broken section of the mountain path and lands on the opposite platform.

The movement is a controlled supernatural burst, not teleportation. The guardian emerges through the distant fortress ruins.

SFX: Energy activation, rapid footsteps, stone landing, supernatural pulse.

[00:21–00:25] — THE MOUNTAIN CHASE

The protagonist runs along a narrow cliffside path bordered by ancient stone walls and pine trees.

The guardian leaps from a higher ridge and lands behind her, sending loose stones down the mountain.

She looks back briefly, then dodges beneath a falling wooden beam and reaches a circular stone platform overlooking a waterfall.

Notification: “GUARDIAN APPROACHING”

SFX: Heavy creature movement, falling rocks, waterfall, urgent orchestral score.

[00:25–00:28] — FIRST COUNTERATTACK

The protagonist turns, draws a short curved sword and raises the moonstone talisman.

The tiger lunges.

She performs a precise dodge roll, avoiding its massive paw. The guardian crashes into the stone platform, creating realistic fractures and scattering debris.

She activates the moonstone and fires a concentrated pale-blue energy burst into a glowing marking on the guardian's shoulder.

The creature recoils. Its health bar loses a small section.

Notification: “WEAK POINT EXPOSED”

SFX: Dodge movement, heavy impact, magical pulse, stone cracking, roar.

[00:28–00:30] — BOSS ENCOUNTER BEGINS

The guardian rises through the mist and roars. Additional glowing markings appear across its body.

The protagonist steadies herself, sword in one hand and moonstone energy gathering in the other.

Objective: “DEFEAT THE MOUNTAIN GUARDIAN”

The camera settles behind her as she begins moving toward the guardian. End during active gameplay, with the boss battle continuing beyond the clip.

REALISM AND VISUAL QUALITY:

Photorealistic next-generation AAA game rendering, physically based materials, realistic skin, detailed hair, natural cloth physics, believable creature anatomy, high-quality fur simulation, accurate stone and wood destruction, volumetric mountain mist, natural lighting, realistic water, environmental particles and detailed Korean-inspired architecture.

The white tiger must feel colossal, heavy and physically present. Its fur, movement, weight, impacts and interaction with the environment must be convincing.

The protagonist must maintain consistent identity, clothing and proportions. Movement should feel player-controlled, with realistic momentum, foot placement, climbing, jumping, dodging and sword handling.

The environment must remain geographically coherent: fortress, shrine, courtyard, mountain paths and final platform must connect naturally.

NEGATIVE REQUIREMENTS:

No anime, cartoon, cel shading, mobile-game graphics, first-person perspective, guns, modern technology, gore, blood, dismemberment, distorted anatomy, changing character identity, changing clothing, duplicated NPCs, teleporting objects, floating objects, unrealistic physics, excessive motion blur, cinematic black bars, subtitles, dialogue, logos, random camera cuts, low-detail environments or disconnected montage sequences.

FINAL DIRECTION:

A visually stunning, realistic AAA Korean-inspired fantasy RPG gameplay clip combining mountain fortress exploration, supernatural relic mechanics, dynamic traversal, environmental destruction, and a massive white tiger boss encounter. It must feel like actual playable next-generation gameplay, not an AI-generated movie trailer.

[00:12–00:17] — FORTRESS COLLAPSE

The guardian strikes the shrine wall, causing the fortress to collapse.

The protagonist sprints through the courtyard as wooden beams and roof tiles fall around her. She slides beneath a collapsing timber, jumps across a broken stone bridge, and grabs a hanging rope attached to an old wooden watchtower.

She swings over a deep ravine and lands on a narrow stone ledge. The camera follows the movement naturally, showing misty mountains and waterfalls below.

Objective: “ESCAPE THE FORTRESS”

SFX: Falling debris, cracking wood, rope tension, rushing wind, distant roar.

[00:17–00:21] — MOONSTEP ABILITY

The protagonist reaches a ruined mountain gate overlooking a fog-filled valley.

The moonstone glows intensely.

Prompt: “ACTIVATE MOONSTEP”

She activates the relic, creating a short luminous trail beneath her feet. She dashes across a broken section of the mountain path and lands on the opposite platform.

The movement is a controlled supernatural burst, not teleportation. The guardian emerges through the distant fortress ruins.

SFX: Energy activation, rapid footsteps, stone landing, supernatural pulse.

[00:21–00:25] — THE MOUNTAIN CHASE

The protagonist runs along a narrow cliffside path bordered by ancient stone walls and pine trees.

The guardian leaps from a higher ridge and lands behind her, sending loose stones down the mountain.

She looks back briefly, then dodges beneath a falling wooden beam and reaches a circular stone platform overlooking a waterfall.

Notification: “GUARDIAN APPROACHING”

SFX: Heavy creature movement, falling rocks, waterfall, urgent orchestral score.

[00:25–00:28] — FIRST COUNTERATTACK

The protagonist turns, draws a short curved sword and raises the moonstone talisman.

The tiger lunges.

She performs a precise dodge roll, avoiding its massive paw. The guardian crashes into the stone platform, creating realistic fractures and scattering debris.

She activates the moonstone and fires a concentrated pale-blue energy burst into a glowing marking on the guardian's shoulder.

The creature recoils. Its health bar loses a small section.

Notification: “WEAK POINT EXPOSED”

SFX: Dodge movement, heavy impact, magical pulse, stone cracking, roar.

[00:28–00:30] — BOSS ENCOUNTER BEGINS

The guardian rises through the mist and roars. Additional glowing markings appear across its body.

The protagonist steadies herself, sword in one hand and moonstone energy gathering in the other.

Objective: “DEFEAT THE MOUNTAIN GUARDIAN”

The camera settles behind her as she begins moving toward the guardian. End during active gameplay, with the boss battle continuing beyond the clip.

REALISM AND VISUAL QUALITY:

Photorealistic next-generation AAA game rendering, physically based materials, realistic skin, detailed hair, natural cloth physics, believable creature anatomy, high-quality fur simulation, accurate stone and wood destruction, volumetric mountain mist, natural lighting, realistic water, environmental particles and detailed Korean-inspired architecture.

The white tiger must feel colossal, heavy and physically present. Its fur, movement, weight, impacts and interaction with the environment must be convincing.

The protagonist must maintain consistent identity, clothing and proportions. Movement should feel player-controlled, with realistic momentum, foot placement, climbing, jumping, dodging and sword handling.

The environment must remain geographically coherent: fortress, shrine, courtyard, mountain paths and final platform must connect naturally.

NEGATIVE REQUIREMENTS:

No anime, cartoon, cel shading, mobile-game graphics, first-person perspective, guns, modern technology, gore, blood, dismemberment, distorted anatomy, changing character identity, changing clothing, duplicated NPCs, teleporting objects, floating objects, unrealistic physics, excessive motion blur, cinematic black bars, subtitles, dialogue, logos, random camera cuts, low-detail environments or disconnected montage sequences.

FINAL DIRECTION:

A visually stunning, realistic AAA Korean-inspired fantasy RPG gameplay clip combining mountain fortress exploration, supernatural relic mechanics, dynamic traversal, environmental destruction, and a massive white tiger boss encounter. It must feel like actual playable next-generation gameplay, not an AI-generated movie trailer.
